# Notable AI Creative Projects Since March 2023

## Film & Video
- **Sora showcase films** (early 2024) - OpenAI's text-to-video model produced surreal short films that sparked widespread discussion
- **"The Frost"** - AI-generated short film using Runway Gen-2 that gained festival attention
- **Music videos** by artists like Washed Out using AI generation throughout

## Music
- **"Heart on My Sleeve"** - Viral AI-generated song mimicking Drake/The Weeknd (quickly removed, sparked industry debate)
- **Grimes' open licensing** of her voice for AI-generated tracks
- **Holly Herndon's Holly+** continued experiments with voice cloning as artistic tool

## Visual Art
- **Refik Anadol's large-scale installations** at venues like MoMA using AI data sculptures
- **AI-assisted graphic novels** and comics gaining mainstream publication
- Expansion of AI art at major fairs (controversial but prominent)

## Interactive/Other
- **AI Dungeon and character.ai narratives** evolved into collaborative storytelling platforms
- **AI-assisted game development** tools producing indie games
- **Architecture and fashion designs** generated with Midjourney/DALL-E seeing real production

## What stood out
The shift from novelty toward integration—creators using AI as one tool among many rather than the sole gimmick.

Want me to expand on any category?
